articles.t: GTA 6's pirate PC ports: new tools, old problem | Opinion
articles.chapeau: Take-Two can play whack-a-mole on GitHub, but ubiquitous new tools mean recompiled games are a genie that won't go back in the bottle. The only fix is to beat t
articles.txt:
I'm sorry in advance. I know we'd all far prefer to be spending our time running around the sun-soaked dystopia of Vice City this week rather than spending it reading yet another column about the game, but we need to talk about GTA 6 again. Specifically, we need to talk about the side story that's spun off from the game's launch – namely the scramble to get it running on PC, before Rockstar itself has so much as officially announced a PC version. It's a story that's getting an outsized amount of attention precisely because GTA 6 is involved, but the consequences of what's playing out will reach far beyond Rockstar or Take-Two.
The short version of events: within a day of GTA 6's launch last week, game files from an Xbox build were circulating online , and a project called Leonida appeared on GitHub with the aim of recompiling the Xbox code into a native Windows application. Within days, it had a Discord server with close to 180,000 members and almost 3,000 forks of its code had sprung up. On Monday, GitHub enforced a DMCA notice from Take-Two against the entire network of 3,007 repositories , and Leonida's creator – reportedly a 15-year-old – threw in the towel.
The DMCA notice was never going to be the end of this story; if anything, the Streisand effect kicked in with a vengeance, with reporting of the takedown bringing awareness of the porting efforts to an even wider audience. Copies of Leonida's code have been picked up and carried on elsewhere, and multiple rival projects are pressing ahead. At least one of them claims to have the game booting on Windows already – albeit running at very low framerates once you get out into the world.
There's more than a hint of Canute commanding the tide about Take-Two's legal efforts, as they're no doubt aware. The people involved are numerous and largely anonymous, the tools they're using are freely available, and anyone with the skills to contribute to a port project like this can certainly spin up a private git server to hold their code without breaking a sweat.
Aggressive legal whack-a-mole will slow things down and give some of the people involved in the various projects cold feet, no doubt. But it still seems very likely that there will be a working – or some degree of "working" – pirate version of GTA 6 running on PCs well ahead of any official PC release from Rockstar.
It's worth noting that in this particular case, leaked files are a key part of the story. Leonida was built on top of stolen files, making Take-Two's legal position even more straightforward than it would be otherwise – but from a technical standpoint, the leak probably gave the port projects only a marginal head start.
Even without the leaked Xbox copy of the game, the ground beneath us has shifted with regard to situations like this. The effort and skill required to turn a console game into a PC one without the publisher's involvement have been dramatically dialled down, a change which applies whether the code comes from a leaked build or a retail copy.
A few weeks ago I wrote about the wave of AI-driven, semi-automated "decompilations" that has swamped the retro gaming scene ; those same techniques are now being turned on brand new releases. In an interview on this site earlier this week , Tinybuild's Alex Nichiporchik talked about how easy it had been for someone to make an unauthorised port of Graveyard Keeper using REA (Reverse Engineer Anything). This isn't a problem unique to the world's biggest game – it's just that GTA 6 has made headline news out of a problem that's even more concerning for smaller companies and games.
Will any of this take the lustre off GTA 6's launch? Not really. The vast majority of people interested in the game are not going to start messing around with dodgy torrent trackers and arcane terminal commands to get a juddering, half-functional build running on their PCs – especially with fake "GTA 6 PC" downloads already doing the rounds as malware delivery vehicles. But in all likelihood, next week's build will judder less and function more, and so will the one the week after that.
Nonetheless, when the game launches officially on PC, it will still be enormous. But it won't escape people's notice that the pirate version got there first, and that's a notion the industry really doesn't want taking root in consumers' minds.

articles.t: If you're not using Auto Drive and Cinematic Camera in GTA 6, you're missing out on some of the best experiences in the game (and a cheeky, free 'fast travel' alternative, too)
articles.chapeau: The cinematic camera, buried in GTA 6's settings a little bit, may be one of the game's best-kept secrets.
articles.txt:
I have just successfully busted a Kingfisher operation just north of Cottonmouth Lake in Mariana County. It was beautiful. Jason took point, armed with a shotgun liberated from an M7 clubhouse, guarding a chokepoint as hordes of rednecks threw themselves at him in an unceremonious, slightly humiliating pantomime of existential futility. Lucia, confident in her improving gunmanship, stood behind, aimed over Jason's broad shoulders, and took out stragglers with a custom hunting rifle pilfered from the Kingfisher's own safehouse. Not so safe anymore, is it, losers? This one's for Donnie, I think as I kneecap the final goon and rifle through their safe.
"That one was for Donnie," Lucia says to Jason as they get in their favourite car - Jason's sunset yellow Declasse '72 Tulip, with a suped up engine and custom parts. God damn, I think, this game can read my mind . And I'm not sure if I would have had this intimate little moment of grief and reconciliation if I hadn't got in the habit of using the game's Cinematic Camera. Your dual protagonists can chat even when you, the player, are in the driving seat - of course - but there's so much going on in the world of Leonida (and so many pedestrians and motorists that like to behave like maniacs and cut you off) that I find their conversations are often cut short or terminated altogether by the chaos of the world.
So, hopping into the car, hitting 'down' on the D-Pad and then hitting 'Start' will instigate the Cinematic Camera, and if you've already set a destination on the map or via the handy new quick navigational menu (simply hold 'down' to see this), your chosen lovebird will start automatically driving to their next location. For me, in this example, it was the Pelican River to Vice City's Bayside, and Boobie's apartment. Probably about 15 minutes of real-world time; enough space to fuss my dog, grab a drink, reply to my editor, and really take the time to soak in the absurd level of detail Rockstar has crammed into its opus. On this specific journey, I also heard a really touching, sweet interaction about Jason's insecurities regarding Lucai's mum. Goosebumps.
GTA 6 is an action-packed game; there aren't a lot of menial jobs going for Jason and Lucia - they're on the run, after all, so I don't think a traditional PAYE-compliant nine-to-five is really on the cards. As such, even the smaller money-making activities on offer are quite stressful: dirt-track events, street racing, pawn store robberies, hit-and-runs, stick-ups… there's only so much a bit of meditation in a park can do to decompress you. So I've taken to enjoying life on the roads. After a big, somewhat impromptu heist on two Kingfisher operations, I need a bit of time to slow down and smell the proverbial roses (or should that be Tulips?).
Jumping into Jason's car, turning the radio to The Chamber 106.6, and letting the star-crossed lovers meander their way home listening to Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya play a selection of metal tracks from the past four decades is good for my brain. I actually think these moments of leisure are essential to the rhythm of GTA 6: dial it up, cool it off. It creates this almost tidal ebb and flow, the resultant flotsam and jetsam ending up fenced or stashed as the rhythm dictates.
I'm usually a very active and fussy player when it comes to games; I can't stand long cutscenes taking control away from me, and I absolutely will skip story scenes on a second playthrough if it's getting in the way of hands-on controller time. So I'm quite surprised at the ease with which I've given up my agency for these longer rides. But it's a testament to Rockstar's writing. I want to see what Jason and Lucia are saying to each other. I want the camera to show me the world passing me by outside my window as I get from A to B. I even sometimes schedule and phase in little detours to C and D, to be honest, because I feel so zen as I watch the bruise-coloured sky sets over the Keys (and I want to hear the end of Symphony of Destruction, maybe).
My Lucia is dressed a bit like someone you'll see cutting about outside Nottingham's Rock City club - cute little tank top, leather jacket, nose and ear piercings galore. One afternoon, after driving out to Hamlet to have a long overdue catch-up with her mum, I set the Cinematic Camera and auto-drive settings on to take her back to meet Jason at a bar (another place, incidentally, you can turn on the Cinematic Camera and just watch them hang out together)

Justice et GTA VI réunis à Paris pour une soirée exclusive
articles.chapeau: Après avoir signé une partie de l’univers musical de GTA VI, Justice s’associe à Rockstar Games pour une soirée exceptionnelle à Paris. Rendez-vous le 3 décembre prochain.
articles.txt:
Save this story Save Story Save this story Le raz-de-marée de GTA VI n’est pas près de s’arrêter. Tandis que le nouveau jeu séduit des millions de joueurs et affole les compteurs, les amateurs de musique se délectent, quant à eux, d’une bande-son électro imaginée par le duo français Justice . Celle-ci rassemble quelques tubes contemporains, de Lana Del Rey à The Weeknd en passant par Cardi B , et réserve également son lot de surprises, à l’instar de “Danse ta nuit”, la reprise de Sylvie Vartan . Au total, près de 30 morceaux composent cette partition addictive, diffusée sur les radios fictives de Vice City, la ville imaginaire de GTA VI .
Une soirée spéciale Justice x GTA VI Mais le phénomène dépasse désormais les frontières du jeu vidéo... Sur Spotify, “Flower in a Hurricane” de Justice s’impose comme le titre le plus écouté de cette playlist, avec 10,2 millions d’écoutes depuis la sortie du jeu. Il devance “Suzuki” de Fuerza Regida et “Go Easy” de Dua Lipa . Les joueurs semblent donc décidés à prolonger l’expérience au-delà de leur écran. Preuve de cet enthousiasme, les fans pourront bientôt se retrouver dans la capitale pour une soirée dédiée à cet univers musical. Baptisé “Grand Theft Auto VI : A Night With Justice”, l’événement est organisé par Justice avec Rockstar Games. Le rendez-vous est donné le 3 décembre prochain au Mia Mao, dans le XIXe arrondissement de Paris . Au programme : une nuit de musique avec un line-up qui sera dévoilé le jour même. De quoi patienter jusqu’au 11 décembre, date à laquelle sortira sur toutes les plateformes l’album de musique originale Grand Theft Auto VI : Original Score by Justice, composé par Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay pour l’univers de GTA VI .

articles.t: Et si GTA 6 avait ravivé la nostalgie des soirées de lancement des années 2000 ?
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 et la soirée de lancement à Miami : un clin d’œil aux fêtes des années 2000, où les stars célébraient la sortie des jeux vidéo.
articles.txt:
Save this story Save Story Save this story Le phénomène GTA 6 est partout… Certains ont pris des vacances pour y jouer car ils l'attendaient depuis 13 ans. D’autres encore, bien qu’ils ne le connaissaient pas jusqu'à présent, sont fascinés par le jeu, notamment grâce à ses références à la culture pop, aux outfits ultra mode du jeu à la musique . La sortie de GTA 6 ( Grand Theft Auto VI ) a été une opération planifiée dans les moindres détails, et c’est peut-être pour cela que, depuis plus d’une semaine, on ne parle que de ça sur Internet. Avec les voix de Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Travis Scott et Dua Lipa , ce sont justement les liens les plus inattendus entre le monde des jeux vidéo et des univers parallèles qui ont retenu l’attention. À commencer par la soirée de lancement, qui a mis à l’honneur Alex Consani dans une mini-robe sur le thème du jeu vidéo, et Lana Del Rey , avec un sac Birkin personnalisé aux couleurs emblématiques du nouveau GTA.
15 millions de précommandes, un budget estimé à 1 milliard de dollars, un trailer vu 306 millions de fois : la sortie ce jour de GTA VI ne pourrait être qu'une histoire de chiffres. C'est aussi et surtout celle d'une franchise qui a su prendre le contrôle de la pop culture.
Le revival des fêtes de lancement de jeux Une telle participation à l’événement, surtout de la part d’une artiste comme Lana Del Rey , qui se montre rarement à ce genre de rendez-vous, rappelle un peu les soirées de lancement du début des années 2000, où, outre les avant-premières de films hollywoodiens ou les défilés et leurs after-parties , les célébrités étaient les invités vedettes des lancements de jeux vidéo. Il n’était pas rare que Paris Hilton , Lindsay Lohan , les sœurs Kardashian , mais aussi des personnalités plus éloignées des feux de la rampe, comme Scarlett Johansson ou Mohamed Ali , participent à ce genre d’événement. Et même si cette époque ne reviendra plus, l’attention collective portée à GTA 6 a également favorisé cette vague de nostalgie.
M. Caulfield/WireImage for PMK/HBH Christopher Polk/FilmMagic Frazer Harrison/Getty Images GTA 6 et la soirée de lancement à Miami avec Alex Consani et Lana Del Rey Dans le plus pur style “Vice City”, nom de la ville où se déroule le jeu vidéo, elle-même inspirée de Miami, la soirée de lancement de GTA 6 s’est déroulée dans la “Magic City” de Floride. Parmi les invités, on comptait divers chanteurs, dont des rappeurs comme Quavo et JT (que l’on avait vu pour la dernière fois lors du défilé printemps-été 2027 de Chanel ), mais aussi des artistes comme Lana Del Rey , qui, bien qu’elle ne figure pas sur les photos officielles, aurait participé à l’événement, comme le laisse supposer une publication sur son compte Instagram , où on la voit aux côtés de son mari, Jeremy Dufrene , avec un sac Birkin dans le style de GTA 6 .
Au-delà des célébrités invitées, la mode et les accessoires ont été les véritables vedettes de l’événement. Outre le sac de Lana Del Rey , la robe d’ Alex Consani incarnait elle aussi pleinement le thème de la soirée. Le mannequin s’est en effet présenté à la séance photo dans une mini-robe composée de ceintures de sécurité factices, signée par la marque Sevali , déjà connue pour avoir habillé des personnalités telles que FKA twigs , Bella Hadid et Charli xcx .
Au début des années 2000, les célébrités ne s’habillaient peut-être pas selon un thème précis, mais tout le monde était présent aux soirées de lancement des jeux vidéo. Qu’il s’agisse du lancement d’une nouvelle console Nintendo, PlayStation ou Xbox , acteurs, sportifs, chanteurs et stars de la télé-réalité participaient sans distinction aux lancements des nouveaux jeux vidéo sur le marché. Les princesses de la culture festive américaine de l’époque, Paris Hilton et Lindsay Lohan, étaient des habituées de ces événements. Elles étaient rejointes par les actrices et acteurs de films et de séries comme Cheetah Girls ou Grey’s Anatomy, une manette à la main ou les télécommandes recouvertes de silicone de la Wii.
Le seul élément qui les distinguait, c’étaient la mode et les tendances beauté de l’époque : Liam Hemsworth et ses écharpes, les pantalons capri de Brittany Snow et Kristen Bell, les pinces à cheveux de Dominique Swain, les bandeaux scintillants de Paris Hilton. C’est à cette dernière, et à son émission de téléréalité The Simple Life (dans laquelle elle partage l’affiche avec Nicole Richie ), que l’on doit la diffusion d’une multitude de tendances. articles.t: GTA 6 affole le marché du hardware : les ventes de manettes PS5 explosent de 355 % - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 stimule les ventes de matériel gaming au Royaume-Uni : +355 % pour les manettes PS5, +94 % pour les casques et +30 % pour les SSD externes.
articles.txt:
Le succès commercial de GTA 6 profite pas seulement à Rockstar. Il concerne aussi les fabricants de consoles et d’accessoires gaming. De nouvelles données révèlent une envolée spectaculaire des achats de manettes, de casques audio et même de SSD au Royaume-Uni. Ces chiffres sont issus de sa première semaine de lancement seulement.
Entre le 15 et le 21 novembre 2026, le commerce britannique spécialisé dans les jeux vidéo a généré un chiffre d’affaires estimé à 142 millions de livres sterling, soit une progression de 99 % par rapport à la semaine précédente. GTA 6 n’était pourtant disponible que durant les trois derniers jours de cette période.
Ce boost ne concerne pas que les ventes de consoles. Les dépenses consacrées aux accessoires gaming atteignent pas moins de 21 millions de livres sterling, en progression de 123 % sur une semaine.
Dans le détail, les ventes de manettes en volume progressent de 194 %, avec un bond particulièrement impressionnant de 355 % pour les modèles PS5. Les casques gaming enregistrent une hausse de 94 %, tandis que les batteries et stations de recharge progressent de 69 %.
Le stockage est également concerné. Les ventes de SSD externes destinés aux consoles augmentent de 30 %, signant leur meilleure semaine depuis le début de l’année 2026. Même les fauteuils gaming bénéficient de cette dynamique avec une progression de 32 %.
Du côté des consoles maintenant les ventes de PlayStation 5 progressent de 46 % contre 75 % pour les Xbox Series X et S.
Tous ces chiffres confirment une nouvelle fois qu’un titre peut bousculer certains marchés du hardware dans le bons sens. C’est également un point positif pour une éventuelle édition PC de GTA 6. Un lancement sur cette plateforme devrait également stimuler les achats de composants, notamment les cartes graphiques et les SSD.
Enfin, les données de NielsenIQ concernent exclusivement le marché britannique et excluent les achats de jeux réalisés directement sur les boutiques numériques des constructeurs.

GTA 6 : le jeu est-il prévu sur PC ?
articles.chapeau: Les joueurs PC pourront-ils un jour arpenter Vice City ? Et si oui, quand ? Voici ce que l’on sait vraiment de GTA 6 sur PC, entre déclarations officielles et rumeurs.
articles.txt:
Des millions de joueurs ont déjà pris la route de Leonida sur console, mais une partie du public reste sur le bord du chemin : les joueurs PC . Comme souvent chez Rockstar , Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) a fait ses débuts sur consoles, laissant les adeptes du clavier et de la souris dans l'expectative.
Entre les déclarations prudentes de Take-Two , les rumeurs de date et les précédents de la saga, difficile de démêler le vrai du faux. GTA 6 est-il disponible sur PC ? Une version est-elle prévue ? Et quand pourrait-elle arriver ? Le point sur ce que l'on sait réellement.
Non. GTA 6 est sorti uniquement sur PS5 et Xbox Series . La page officielle du jeu sur le site de Rockstar Games ne mentionne que ces deux plateformes : pas de version PC dans les boutiques en ligne, pas de configuration requise publiée, pas de précommande possible. Si vous tombez sur un site proposant de télécharger "GTA 6 PC", passez votre chemin : il s'agit au mieux d'une arnaque, au pire d'un logiciel malveillant.
Officiellement, rien n'est annoncé. Rockstar n'a jamais évoqué de version PC , et Take-Two , sa maison mère, botte en touche. Interrogé à plusieurs reprises, son PDG Strauss Zelnick s'en tient à la même ligne : GTA 6 n'a été annoncé que sur consoles "pour le moment", et toute annonce concernant le PC viendra de Rockstar.
Personne chez Take-Two n'a pour autant exclu une version PC. Tous les grands jeux récents de Rockstar ont fini par arriver sur ordinateur, et le marché PC est devenu bien trop important pour être ignoré. La question n'est donc pas tant de savoir si GTA 6 sortira sur PC, mais quand.
Aucune date officielle n'existe. Une rumeur circule toutefois avec insistance : selon le média américain GamesBeat , qui s'appuie sur quatre sources proches du dossier, Rockstar viserait le premier trimestre 2027 pour la version PC, soit une sortie entre janvier et mars 2027. Rockstar n'a pas souhaité commenter cette information. Elle est donc à prendre avec des pincettes.
Si elle se confirmait, ce serait une petite révolution. Rockstar a en effet l'habitude de faire patienter les joueurs PC bien plus longtemps.
Une sortie au premier trimestre 2027 ramènerait l'attente à quelques mois seulement, un record pour un grand jeu Rockstar. À l'inverse, si le studio suivait le rythme de Red Dead Redemption 2 , il faudrait plutôt viser fin 2027. Nous mettrons cet article à jour dès que Rockstar aura annoncé une date.

articles.t: GTA 6 Permanent Stat Boosts – How to Increase Health, Stamina, and Focus
articles.chapeau: Find all permanent stat boosts in GTA 6, including how to increase max Health, Stamina, and Focus and which upgrades you can miss.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google In Grand Theft Auto VI , some of the best upgrades are hidden in side quests you can drive right past. You can raise your max Health by visiting Hell, boost your Stamina by completing a mushroom obstacle course, and increase all three stats by rescuing an alien. Here’s where to find the permanent stat boosts in GTA 6 , including the Chapter 1 Focus reward and the choice you should make at the end of the No Flushers quest.
You can permanently increase your max Health, Stamina, and Focus in GTA 6 by completing hidden encounters and side activities. If you’re still in Chapter 1 , get Shirley’s rum before starting “Tourist Trap.”
“Get Shirley’s Rum” is a Chapter 1 side mission that gives Jason a Focus increase. It disappears as soon as you start “Tourist Trap.” When Shirley calls out to Jason near her house in Key Lento on the way to “Pipework,” stop and talk to her. Head south to Three Sheets Liquor, ask the clerk for her rum, then bring the bottle back to Shirley.
After flushing Dr. Merle, step into the chamber yourself before leaving the sewage plant. You’ll wake up with a permanent increase to max Stamina. Whether you can return for the boost after leaving is unclear. However you will miss out on the stat increase if you exit the building and don’t flush yourself.
In Chapter 2, scan the crop-dusting flyer outside Starlet Motel reception and head to McKittrick Farm. Finish Kyle’s crop-dusting job, then come back for his follow-up job to collect chemicals. Choose Eat when Kyle offers you the mutated strawberry.
Head to the garage in North Port Gellhorn between 10 PM and 4 AM in-game . Look for the red glow and “Welcome to Hellhole” graffiti. Talk to the people inside to start the encounter, then finish the fight for a max Health increase and the Legendary Hellspawn Comshot 12 Shotgun. Our Hellspawn Shotgun guide has the map location and boss walkthrough.
From Chapter 2 onward, check the road near Starlet Motel late at night for a car with flashing lights. Follow the trail of clothes into the woods, then return to the car when prompted to trigger the abduction. Afterward, sleep as the same character until you get the alien dream.
Complete the dream puzzle, then follow its clues to the real facility and rescue the alien. The final rescue increases max Health, Stamina, and Focus .
Use WAiNK to scan the #NOFLUSHERS poster in the Corsair Key restroom, then follow the marker to meet Dr. Merle at Frank’s Waffles. Follow his quest to the sewage treatment plant. After you use the red button to flush Merle, step into the chamber yourself. You’ll wake up with increased max Stamina.
Head to the work site near Lake Tallaloko, north of Milliport, and look for a shipping container with a “???” interaction inside. Use it to start the obstacle course, then make your way across the crates and logs to the finish. The character who completes the course gets a max Stamina increase .
Listen for gunfire near the road construction site east of Port Gellhorn. Pick up the rifle by the group to start the practice round, then take the $250 wager and win the iguana challenge for a max Focus increase .
Head to the IAA Black Site in North Mariana County and enter 085355 on the keypad attached to the tree. Restore power in the bunker, activate both hangar buttons, then sit in the chair in front of the TV to start the Brainwashed sequence. Completing the sequence gives you a permanent Focus increase. Pick up the Brainwasher 1922 pistol by the TV when you return.
Earn gold on every course at Griffin Shooting Range for a Focus increase. You can earn another by doing the same at Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range . Meditation spots a r ound Leonida are another way to improve Focus as you explore.

articles.t: GTA 6 Is Hiding A Diablo And A Demon In Its Garages, And Rockstar Clearly Has A Type
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's hidden cars aren't random. A devil, a demon and a Fast and Furious icon are waiting in Leonida, if you know where to look.
articles.txt:
By Hari Krishnan Published Nov 27, 2026, 9:15 AM EST Hari is an automotive journalist and MA Automotive Journalism student at Coventry University, whose passion for cars began long before it became a profession. Born and raised in Kerala, India, he spent years immersed in car culture before channelling that obsession into a career built on storytelling, research, and genuine enthusiasm for machines that move people.
He cut his teeth in automotive media at Flywheel — the platform founded by Hani Musthafa, the most prominent automotive journalist from South India and the only journalist from the region to serve on the World Car of the Year jury panel. Over two years, Hari produced and managed over 1,000 pieces of digital content across Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms, covered OEM press events for brands including Mercedes-Benz, Kia, Tata Motors, and MG Motor India, and built the visual and editorial framework that brought the platform back to life from scratch.
Alongside his studies, Hari runs Living Metals Media, an independent automotive blog covering everything from exotic hypercars to motorsport history, where his voice as a writer has been sharpened one article at a time.
Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for a few days, and players are already tearing through Leonida hunting for its hidden cars. A viral community map claims there are 36 rare rides waiting to be found, and some of the best finds will look pretty familiar to car enthusiasts. We're talking Lamborghini-inspired supercars, a modern American muscle icon, and even a tribute to one of the most recognizable cars from The Fast and the Furious .
Some of GTA 6's best hidden rides are based on real-world legends. The Pegassi Infernus Classic takes plenty of inspiration from the Lamborghini Diablo , the wedge-shaped Italian supercar that ended up on half the bedroom walls of the 1990s. The real thing launched in 1990 with a 5.7-liter V12 making 485 hp, and it was the first Lamborghini to crack 200 mph. Then there's the Pegassi Tempesta, which is basically a Lamborghini Huracán in a fake mustache. If American muscle is more your thing, the Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire should grab your attention. Its design draws heavily from the Dodge Challenger SRT Demon , although its name also nods to Dodge's Hellcat models.
A quick refresher on what the Demon actually is. It's a supercharged 6.2-liter V8 making 840 hp on 100-octane race fuel; it ran a 9.65-second quarter mile at 140 mph, and it holds a Guinness record for the longest wheelie from a standing start by a production car. In a game where you can just steal one, that's dangerous information. Notice a theme? Diablo is Spanish for devil, Infernus comes from the Latin for hell, and Hellfire is a Demon in disguise. Somebody at Rockstar clearly has a type.
Front 3/4 view of Maibatsu Penumbra FF '97 from GTA 6 YouTube/ Maka91Productions The standout discovery so far is a green Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF tucked inside a house garage on Vespucci Island. If it looks familiar, it should. It's a dead ringer for Brian O'Conner's green 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse from 2001's The Fast and the Furious , driven by the late Paul Walker. That green paint and those graphics are pure early-2000s tuner scene, and that's exactly the point. The Eclipse was Brian's first race car, the one he pushed with way too much nitrous racing Dom. Better still, you don't need to grind through a major mission to get it. Walk in, take it, and register it if you want to keep it. With a Diablo, a Demon and Brian's Eclipse already out there, Leonida's garages are well worth raiding.

GTA 6 : le parc inspiré de Disney World que Rockstar a choisi de ne pas construire dans son jeu...
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games a annoncé, dans un entretien accordé à nos confrères de Videogames Chronicle avoir envisagé d'intégrer un parc d’attractions inspiré de Disney World dans GTA 6. Dans un entretien publié le 26 novembre 2026, le producteur Rob Nelson explique pourquoi le studio a préféré privilégier les activités liées à l’histoire de Jason et Lucia. On fait le point !
articles.txt:
Vice City emprunte ses traits à Miami , et Leonida, l'État fictif de Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) , s'inspire de la Floride jusque dans ses marais et ses plages de sable blanc. Il manque pourtant à l'appel l'un des symboles les plus célèbres de l'État : Walt Disney World , près d'Orlando, dont le Magic Kingdom reste le parc d'attractions le plus visité au monde.
Les fans espéraient en découvrir une parodie signée Rockstar , d'autant que la saga s'en était déjà moquée par le passé. Interrogé sur cette absence, Rob Nelson , producteur de GTA 6 et codirecteur de Rockstar North , s'est expliqué.
Pour Rob Nelson , tout s'est joué sur une question simple : l'histoire justifiait-elle le temps nécessaire pour créer un parc d'attractions entièrement fonctionnel ? Dans un entretien accordé à Video Games Chronicle et relayé par Numerama , il explique que le studio a d'abord évalué ce dont il avait vraiment besoin pour raconter son histoire et donner à Leonida son identité propre.
Résultat : deux obstacles. D'un côté, l'ampleur du chantier. Un parc digne de ce nom aurait demandé énormément de travail, d'autant que les joueurs auraient attendu des dizaines de manèges utilisables. De l'autre, l'absence de raison narrative assez solide pour y envoyer Jason et Lucia. Le duo de criminels n'avait tout simplement rien à faire au milieu des châteaux de princesse.
Ce raisonnement a guidé tout le choix des loisirs du jeu. Plutôt que d'empiler les activités sans lien avec les personnages, Rockstar a privilégié celles qui avaient un rôle dans l'histoire de Jason et Lucia. Une philosophie qui explique pourquoi Leonida mise davantage sur ses marais, ses plages et ses bas-fonds que sur les grandes attractions touristiques de la Floride.
Oui, et les fans de la première heure s'en souviennent. Dans GTA Vice City , sorti en 2002, des panneaux publicitaires vantaient déjà Fun World , un parc d'attractions parodique au château de conte de fées, sans qu'il soit jamais possible de le visiter. Plus de vingt ans plus tard, Fun World reste donc un mirage, et les joueurs devront se contenter des attractions plus terre à terre de Leonida.

articles.t: Interdimensional Portals and Hidden Bunkers — the Extreme Lengths GTA 6 Players Are Taking to Lose 6 Star Wanted Levels
articles.chapeau: Losing six stars in GTA 6 is meant to be impossible, but players are trying everything from interdimensional portals to hidden bunkers to escape the cops.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 's new police system is one of the most interesting things about the game. Instead of omnipresent cops, the police have have various levels of awareness, and you can use guile and cunning to outsmart them and escape.
There are still wanted stars, which represent how much of the police force is dedicated to hunting you down, but a well-considered escape plan can get you out of most kinds of trouble. Just escape the search zone, lose line of sight, and change how you look to get away.
That is unless you cause too much carnage. If you go off the deep end and cause real mayhem, you’ll eventually reach six stars. Six stars in GTA 6 sees almost the entire map become a search zone, and the cops will never stop tracking you down, according to Rockstar. If you need a pointer, here's how to get a six-star wanted level in GTA 6 .
If you hide indoors, the army comes along with a tank. If you jump in a plane, jets are scrambled to shoot you down. If you try to escape by car, attack helicopters perform a strafing run to blow you off the road. Eventually, no matter how hard you try, you will succumb to the pressure. Six stars, it is thought, amounts to a death sentence.
But is that guaranteed? Since GTA 6 came out, players have been looking for creative ways of breaking the rule around the highest wanted level. Using clever tricks, some are exploring ways to escape a six-star police hunt and return to regular gameplay — which should technically only be possible two ways: you die or get busted.
One player used a series of secret bunkers that you can open up to get access to a GTA 6 tank . Here’s the clip:
⭐️ LE PREMIER JOUEUR AU MONDE A RÉUSSIR À SEMER LES 6 ETOILES SUR GTA 6 ! Il est allé dans un sous sol rempli de bunkers pour réussir à semer la police. https://t.co/8Q0nd27eOn
Another player in the comments said they managed to replicate this by swimming. “Bro, I actually did it yesterday. I managed to escape the 6-star wanted level,” they said . “Just keep diving underwater, and when your oxygen is almost depleted, swim back to the surface. Keep repeating this until you find a jet ski. Then ride it beyond the 6-star search area, and boom! You're free.”
Some players think the underwater cave system in Emerald Springs could be another prime candidate, since cops can’t send diving teams after you. If you head to Emerald Spring and look for signs for the Selkie Hole, there’s diving equipment you can use to explore an underground cave network.
Another player went to more extreme lengths to avoid the cops. After completing the majority of the long Vice City Easter egg in GTA 6 , they left the world through a portal back to the ‘80s. When they came back to present-day Leonida, the cops didn’t care about them or their Tommy Vercetti shirt anymore. Here’s that clip:
“The cops in GTA are so overpowered that you can't escape them unless you go to another world,” said one commenter . “Now THAT'S how you escape the six star wanted level. That’s gangsta,” said another .
One fan also claimed to have escaped six stars by swimming into an underwater research station. Unfortunately, the video doesn’t actually show the six stars vanishing, but I guess they technically escaped, as long as they stay there forever.
6 STARS ESCAPE Underwater Research Facility IN GTA 6 (is coded if you get 6 stars they will recognize you no matter what, testes same thing with 5 stars and it worked) https://t.co/jfZZMzdvs4
It’ll be interesting to see if any new strategies formulate around losing six stars, although getting the full six isn’t something that generally happens by accident in ordinary gameplay. You have to cause a lot of carnage to bring the full weight of Leonida’s police down on your head.

articles.t: GTA VI Cultural Moment: $79.99, Wrong Art Question
articles.chapeau: GTA VI cultural moment explained: $79.99 launch on PS5 and Xbox, no PC date, and why Garry Crawford says the video games art debate misses the point.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Rockstar Games shipped Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, 2026, and the argument about what the release means arrived within days. Garry Crawford of the University of Salford published a piece on The Conversation calling the launch a huge cultural moment and saying it is time to stop asking whether video games are art. His case is simple: the better question is where games already sit in daily life.
That framing matters because it shifts the GTA VI cultural moment from a sales story to a social one. Standard Edition copies cost $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition costs $99.99, per local news coverage of the launch. Those numbers explain the commercial weight. Crawford’s argument explains why mainstream outlets are covering a video game launch the way they cover a film premiere or a sports final.
This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is interpretation. The release date, platforms and prices are on the record. The “cultural moment” label is Crawford’s characterization, and we treat it that way. We also look at how it fits with Rockstar’s standing in the critical rankings , what it means for rivals, and where the evidence runs out.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Crawford’s article, published by The Conversation, makes two linked points. First, he calls Grand Theft Auto VI a huge cultural moment. Second, he says the long-running argument over whether games count as art has run its course. In his words, “But asking whether games are art is possibly the wrong question.”
The second quote carries the weight of his thesis. Crawford writes that what matters is “the place they already hold in people’s lives.” He then adds that broadcasters, sports clubs and others outside gaming are starting to take note. That is a claim about institutions, not about aesthetics. He is saying the proof of cultural standing is behavior, and behavior is measurable in ways that art-critical verdicts are not.
He also points to participation. His article says more than half of British adults play video games. If that holds, games are not a niche pursuit that occasionally breaks out. They are a default leisure activity, and a launch as large as GTA VI lands in a population where most people either play or live with someone who does.
It is worth being precise about what he does not claim. Crawford does not say GTA VI is the best game ever made, and he does not say it settles the art question in the affirmative. He argues the question has stopped being useful. That distinction keeps his piece defensible, and it keeps ours honest too.
Before the analysis, here is the factual floor. Rockstar Games lists Grand Theft Auto VI for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The release date was November 19, 2026. The Standard Edition costs $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition costs $99.99. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date, so any PC timeline in circulation is unconfirmed.
The price gap between editions is $20, a simple subtraction from the two confirmed figures. Take-Two’s investor relations page carries the pre-order announcement from Rockstar , and local outlets such as WAFB ran a launch-day cost explainer framed around the 13-year wait.
Those two sources show the split in coverage. The publisher speaks in product terms. The local broadcaster speaks to a general audience that may never have held a controller. The second audience is the one Crawford says is paying attention.
Crawford’s label is an interpretation, but it rests on observable behavior. PBS NewsHour ran a segment titled around why the release is a major cultural moment. WAFB covered the price as a consumer story. The Conversation devoted a topic hub to the game. None of that proves cultural weight on its own, yet the spread of coverage across a public broadcaster, a local station and an academic publisher is the pattern Crawford describes.
Three things support the framing. The release came after a long wait, which built anticipation outside the core gaming audience. The pricing at $79.99 and $99.99 turned the launch into a household budget decision. And mainstream outlets treated the release as news, not as a product review. Each is observable, and none requires a sales figure that Rockstar has not published.
A cultural moment is not a measurable quantity. Crawford’s article treats it as an argument, and so does the fact record we hold. We cannot

articles.t: Lucia’s Voice Actor Says She Worked on GTA 6 For Almost an Entire Decade
articles.chapeau: The voice actor of one of the game's two protagonists, Manni Perez, also thanked the massive new following she recently started getting.
articles.txt:
The voice actor for Grand Theft Auto 6 protagonist Lucia Caminos, Manni Perez, has revealed in a social media post that she worked with Rockstar on the title for almost an entire decade. In the post, where she thanks the massive new following she has gotten due to her role, she also mentioned that the last few days have been a “whirlwind”.
“Life has been such a whirlwind these past couple of days, and I just want to take a moment to say thank you. Thank you to all the new followers, to all the beautiful messages, and the positive reception the game and my character have received.
“I’ve dedicated almost a decade bringing Lucia to life. She’s been such a significant part of mine, and I am beyond grateful she now gets to be a small part of yours. Happy Holidays y’all.”
The idea that Perez has been working with Rockstar on the game for almost an entire decade shouldn’t come as any surprise, since Rockstar North’s co-studio head, Rob Nelson, has confirmed that work on GTA 6 started as far back as 2015. Back in August, Nelson said that it was part of the studio’s “very long cycles” of game development.
“The majority of the team really started rolling on it after Red Dead Redemption 2 released in 2018. We have to be very careful about what ideas we choose to put in there, because it can take a long time to figure out what our angle is on this. Because by the time we write it and cast it and shoot it, and implement it, whatever it is – it could be gone, it could change, it could be dated.
“And so we’re always trying to think about whether something will stand the test of time. And so, you look at those things, and we only try to pick things if they work with the story we’re trying to tell, in the world we’re trying to tell it in. I think there will always be things to satirise; there are always ridiculous situations and behaviours that we can find, but we just have to be careful about what we pick.”
Interestingly, one could argue that GTA 6 ’s work could be traced back to even 2014, since that’s when Rockstar first started prototyping its NPC interaction system that would first be seen in Red Dead Redemption 2 before its current form in Grand Theft Auto 6 . According to Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier, the system was being prototyped while Rockstar was largely busy working on the PS4, Xbox One, and PC ports of Grand Theft Auto 5 , along with post-launch support for GTA Online .
Schreier had also brought up that the company faced a few difficulties between 2019 and 2022, and things only started improving in 2023, with the company’s vision of GTA 6 finally beginning to take shape.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is available on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and Lucia is one of the title’s two core protagonists alongside Jason Duval. For more details on the game, check out our review .

articles.t: GTA 6 President’s Bunker questline walkthrough: All Locations, Codes, Puzzles and Rewards | VGC
articles.chapeau: How to complete the President’s Bunker mission in GTA 6…
articles.txt:
The President’s Bunker hidden mission in GTA 6 is one of the most complex, but with this guide, you’ll be able to complete it and get the secret tank as a reward.
This GTA 6 President’s Bunker walkthrough explains how to start the mission, find both bunkers, discover every code and collect the exclusive rewards, including a unique pistol, an assault rifle and a military tank.
For even more GTA 6 guides, check out our GTA 6 walkthrough hub.
Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub , featuring beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more.
The GTA 6 President’s Bunker mission starts in Downtown Vice City by speaking to a random man near a statue that comemorates the war. Start by travelling to Downtown, specifically the Friends of Freedom memorial on Catalan Boulevard. Check the image above for the speficic location.
The memorial is dedicated to President Joe Russo and is located in the eastern part of Downtown.Look for an elderly man sitting near the memorial wall. This is Jose Bermudez, the character who introduces players to the hidden bunker storyline.
Approach him and start a conversation. When the dialogue options appear, select:
Jose will begin explaining his version of the Presidential assassination and reveal that he has evidence connected to the incident. This is the start of a questline that leads you to the President’s Bunker. He will also direct you towards his apartment in Little Cuba. He notes that you can find this apartment by looking for a large number of Cuban flags outside the door.
Your next destination is Little Cuba, specifically NW 4th Avenue. Look for a salmon-coloured building decorated with Cuban flags, located near a vehicle modification shop. You can see an image of the apartment building below. Enter the building and head upstairs to find Jose’s apartment.
Inside the apartment, there are several important clues that you should investigate:
Make sure you listen to the complete recording rather than leaving halfway through. The information provided here becomes important when accessing the first bunker if you’re completing the quest organically.
I suppose if you’re reading this then you don’t need to do this at all. Come to think of it, I don’t even know if you need to do this part of the quest before you head to Sharktooth Island.
Once you’ve finished investigating Jose’s apartment, it’s time to travel to the first bunker. The facility is located on Sharktooth Island, a small island north of Waning Sands. Because the location is surrounded by water, taking a boat is recommended. You can also swim across, although travelling by boat is considerably more convenient. If you get stuck out there, there’s a boat that spawns on the opposite shore of the island from the bunker itself.
On the north shore of Sharktooth Island, you’ll find the entrance to the bunker.
After entering the bunker, you’ll discover that the facility has no electricity.
Follow the underground passage and look for the power switch. Turn right inside the tunnel to locate the electrical control panel. Interact with it to restore power. Once the electricity is working, return through the passage and take the opposite route into the main bunker. You’ll now be able to investigate the presidential facility.
Inside the bunker, look around for documents, recordings and other evidence.
On one desk there’s a picture of President Russo meeting with an alien on Mount Chilliad. Mount Chilliad was the site of much speculation in te GTA 5 era due to clues about an apart alien mystery, and the fact that a UFO would appear over the mountain when players 100%’d the game.
Continue looking around the room until you reach the presidential desk. Interact with the desk and investigate its contents. This will help activate the next part of the puzzle. Jason or Lucia will sit back and begin to make jokes about them being President. It doesn’t matter which of the two you play as.
The presidential safe contains one of the most valuable rewards in the entire bunker mission: Russo’s 1922 Pistol.
However, opening it requires solving a small puzzle. Here it is in beat-by-beat steps.
Enter the combination into the safe to unlock it. Inside, you’ll find Russo’s 1922 Pistol and a mysterious photograph which leads to the second part of the quest. Make sure you collect the pistol and inspect the photograph before leaving. On the back of the picture you’ll find the word: OBSESS.

Where to find the Buckingham Jubilee in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: The Buckingham Jubilee can be hard to track down in GTA 6 if you don't know where it is. In this guide, we'll tell you exactly how to find it.
articles.txt:
Looking to get your hands on one of the most luxurious SUVs in GTA 6 ? The Buckingham Jubilee should be right at the top of your list. But finding one isn't quite as easy as cruising around and hoping for the best.
If you're helping Randy complete his Wish List, you'll need to know exactly where to look. Luckily, there are a few locations where this luxury SUV can spawn, and in this guide, we;ll tell you exactly where to find the Buckingham Jubilee in GTA 6.
The first place you can look for this elusive car is in Belville, which is just north of South Leonard County. Plot a course for the circular formation on the map with four houses around it, and visit the first house on the left.
If you're lucky, the Buckingham Jubilee will be sitting in the driveway outside the equally luxurious house. The homeowner might see you, though, so keep that in mind. If you'd rather have more privacy while stealing the Jubilee, there is another place you can search.
If the Buckingham Jubilee isn't in Belville, it may be in Vinewood Beach, which is just to the right of the Waning Sands. The house you're looking for is near the top of the area, so plot a course for the line of houses next to the beach and set off toward your bounty.
The house has a large metal gate facing the street. It's unlocked, so you can walk right on through into the luxurious driveway. And with a bit of luck, the Buckingham Jubilee will be sitting next to the fountain in the center of the drive.
If luck just isn't on your side the first time you try either of these locations, you can always save and reload to refresh the cars, or peruse Shore Drive in Ocean Beach . There could be one parked along the beachfront, but you might run into more trouble there if you try to steal it in the open.
And that finishes our guide on where to find the Buckingham Jubilee in GTA 6. Need more help with the game? Check out our guides on how to fish , how to fast travel and how to fix cars . If it's more car info you're looking for, we also have guides on the Pegassi Infernus and the BF Bandito .

articles.t: Rockstar Games : les salariés du studio de GTA 6 rejettent la reconnaissance syndicale
articles.chapeau: Les salariés de Rockstar Games au Royaume-Uni étaient appelés à voter pour la reconnaissance formelle d'un syndicat. La réponse a été cinglante.
articles.txt:
Les salariés de Rockstar Games au Royaume-Uni étaient appelés à voter pour la reconnaissance formelle d'un syndicat. La réponse a été cinglante.
Rockstar gagne une partie de la bataille syndicale, mais un procès reste en cours. ©Bangla press / Shutterstock Les employés de Rockstar Games au Royaume-Uni se sont prononcés à une large majorité contre la reconnaissance formelle du syndicat IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union. Le scrutin s'est déroulé au même moment où l'entreprise a sorti Grand Theft Auto 6 , qui a généré 3,79 milliards de dollars de précommandes et de ventes dès son premier jour.
Il y a des scrutins à la participation élevée, et c'est le cas ici. Plus de 93 % des salariés des bureaux d'Édimbourg, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee et Londres ont participé à ce vote, organisé sur deux semaines. D'après les chiffres rapportés par IGN, 1 163 d'entre eux ont voté contre la reconnaissance formelle de cette branche de l'IWGB (Independent Workers Union of Great Britain), contre 381 qui y étaient favorables.
Mais alors, que veut dire ce résultat concrètement ? C'est simple, la direction de Rockstar n'a pas l'obligation de reconnaître officiellement le syndicat, ni de tenir des réunions avec ses représentants, ce dernier n'étant pas officiel. Le syndicat indique toutefois qu'il continuera à s'organiser sans accord formel avec l'entreprise.
Dans un communiqué, le syndicat a déclaré : « Pour tous ceux qui, chez Rockstar, croient en un lieu de travail plus juste, en un secteur plus juste et en une société plus juste, ce n'est pas un signal pour battre en retraite, mais pour redoubler d'efforts. » Il souligne que « des centaines de collègues » ont voté en sa faveur, mais reconnaît avoir « encore du travail » pour mieux se faire comprendre et obtenir la confiance d'un plus grand nombre de salariés. « Nous sommes prêts à y consacrer l'énergie nécessaire » , ajoute le communiqué.
L'organisation affirme qu'elle continuera de défendre la transparence des salaires, le paiement contractuel des heures supplémentaires et des protections face à l'intelligence artificielle et aux licenciements.
Jennifer Kolbe, responsable de l'édition chez Rockstar Games, s'est dite fière de son équipe, de la culture développée en commun et du lancement de Grand Theft Auto 6 . Selon elle, le résultat du vote traduit l'attachement des équipes à des relations directes, à la collaboration et à un dialogue ouvert, qui ont contribué à rendre Rockstar « innovant et solide » . Selon ses dires, l'entreprise souhaite désormais s'appuyer sur ce qui a été accompli ensemble.
Rockstar avait pourtant laissé entendre qu'elle était disposée à travailler avec ses employés sur la question syndicale. Jennifer Kolbe avait déclaré à Bloomberg, dans un article consacré à la fabrication de GTA 6 : « Nous allons là où va l'équipe. Donc, s'ils veulent un syndicat, ils auront un syndicat. »
GTA VI 79,99 € Une procédure judiciaire toujours en cours Il faut dire que malgré tout, la situation est quelque peu tendue chez Rockstar. En effet, en octobre dernier, l'entreprise a licencié des dizaines de salariés, affirmant qu'ils auraient partagé des informations confidentielles sur GTA 6 et tenu des propos dénigrant l'entreprise. Récemment, l'entreprise a également licencié un ingénieur accusé d'espionner les joueurs .
L'IWGB a déposé des recours juridiques formels contre Rockstar, filiale de Take-Two, qu'elle accuse de chercher à entraver l'action syndicale et d'avoir licencié ces employés de manière illégale.
Un tribunal des prud'hommes a entendu les plaidoiries finales la semaine dernière. Le jugement définitif n'a pas encore été rendu.

Danny Dyer makes surprise cameo in GTA 6 – but not all fans will find him
articles.chapeau: The ‘Rivals’ star reprises his role from a previous ‘GTA’ game
articles.txt:
Danny Dyer makes surprise cameo in GTA 6 – but not all fans will find him It seems that Danny Dyer is everywhere at the moment, from Jilly Cooper's Rivals to Sky's Saturday Night Live UK – and now you can add the most popular video game of all time, Grand Theft Auto VI , to that list.
The British actor, 49, makes an uncredited cameo in the record-breaking video game, with some players stumbling across him as part of a hidden Easter egg.
Dyer has history with the video game franchise, having voiced cockney music executive Kent Paul in 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City and its follow-up, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas .
Now over 20 years later, Dyer reprises the role in the most recent instalment, GTA VI , but not all fans will be able to track him down.
Danny Dyer voices Kent Michael in a 'Grand Theft Auto VI' cameo (Rockstar Games)
His character appears as part of a hidden feature in the game, if players take either protagonist Jason or Lucia to the top of a radio tower in fictional Leonida town Key Lenton. After opening a highly-secure vault door, they'll find themselves transported back to the pixellated world of GTA: Vice City , where they'll find Kent Paul in the backroom of an 1980's nightclub, snorting cocaine.
"Who're you? Listen mate, you ain't supposed to be here," Dyer's character tells the protagonist. "Unless you're the fairy f***ing gak-mother, which I doubt. I've been leaving messages for that twat all night."
Another time portal then appears, taking the player's protagonist back to the modern world of GTA VI – however, it appears that they take Kent Paul with them as later in the game, they receive phone calls from the character who's adjusting to being in a high-definition environment. "Hello? Where the f*** am I? What is this place?" he says in one phone call. "It looks.. I dunno. It's like I've been blind all me life and now I got the super chang specs. I mean... I thought smashing one out was 'sposed to ruin my eyesight but everything's gone 20-20 3D vision."
Danny Dyer in 'Rivals' as Freddie Jones with co-star Lisa McGrillis, who plays his on-screen wife Valerie (Disney+)
The player later receives another phone call from Dyer's character, in which he's heard singing "I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles" – the anthem of Dyer's football team West Ham United.
Since making his original debut as Kent Michael in 2002, Dyer's career has gone from strength-to-strength, with the actor playing Mick Carter in EastEnders for nine years, hosting BBC One's The Wall , playing businessman Freddie Jones in Rivals and winning a TV Bafta for his performance in Sky comedy Mr. Bigstuff .
GTA VI has smashed records since its release earlier this month, with it becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history after making $3.8bn (£2.9bn) in sales on its first day out.
The game follows criminal couple Jason (Dylan Rourke) and Lucia (Manni L. Perez) as they attempt to rebuilt their lives after Lucia's stint in prison for attempted robbery. The likes of comedian Bobby Moynihan, Widow's Bay star Stephen Root and Orange is the New Black 's Taryn Manning make up the wider cast.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Des milliers de dépôts de recompilation supprimés – mais à quoi cela a-t-il servi ?
articles.chapeau: Take-Two, la maison mère de Rockstar, a fait supprimer plus de 3 000 dépôts de code dans le cadre de sa lutte contre les versions PC non officielles de GTA 6. Reste toutefois à savoir si ces efforts ont vraiment changé la donne.
articles.txt:
Comme nous l’avons déjà rapporté , Take-Two a commencé à déposer des demandes de retrait pour atteinte au droit d’auteur visant les portages non officiels de GTA 6 sur PC. Depuis, environ 3 000 dépôts (des archives en ligne contenant du code source) ont disparu de GitHub. À première vue, l’opération semble de grande ampleur. Mais Take-Two a-t-il vraiment réussi à ralentir le développement des portages non officiels sur PC, ou ces retraits ne sont-ils qu’une goutte d’eau dans l’océan ? À en juger par les réactions au sein de la communauté , la seconde hypothèse semble plus probable.
Des utilisateurs de Reddit soulignent que la grande majorité des dépôts supprimés auraient été des copies d’un seul projet de recompilation et que les principaux projets semblent avoir été épargnés. Certains estiment même que les retraits ont eu l’effet inverse de celui recherché en attirant davantage l’attention sur les projets. Il faut aussi garder à l’esprit que le retrait du code de GitHub n’efface pas les copies locales stockées sur les ordinateurs des développeurs. Autrement dit, la suppression d’un dépôt ne signifie pas nécessairement que le développement doit s’arrêter ou que les développeurs doivent repartir de zéro. Comme le rapporte VideoCardz , le développement se poursuit de plus en plus au sein de groupes privés, ce qui complique l’intervention de l’éditeur.
Un coup d’œil à PortWatchVI, l’outil de suivi géré par la communauté, renforce les doutes quant à l’efficacité de l’opération menée par Take-Two. Le projet de recompilation Belobug a dépassé CGBJ, jusque-là en tête, même si son taux d’avancement de 91,3 % est inférieur de 0,2 point de pourcentage à celui affiché par CGBJ la veille. CGBJ est depuis redescendu à 89,6 %. Il est difficile de déterminer si ces changements sont liés aux retraits demandés par Take-Two. Toutefois, comme les principaux projets semblent avoir été épargnés par l’opération, un lien direct paraît peu probable.
ⓘ Marius Müller for Notebookcheck A screenshot of the community-run tracker PortWatchVI. Avec 18 des 40 projets suivis déjà capables de lancer GTA 6 ( actuellement disponible sur Amazon pour 80 dollars ), faire fermer des projets un par un a peu de chances de suffire. Il reste difficile de mesurer à quel point ces retraits ont ralenti le développement, d’autant que de plus en plus de développeurs pourraient poursuivre leur travail au sein de groupes privés. Pour l’instant, du moins, les données publiques ne montrent guère de signes d’un revers majeur.

articles.t: Meilleure voiture pour fuir la police dans GTA 6 : Jugular, Neon, Raiden… le classement des guides
articles.chapeau: Quelle voiture pour semer la police dans GTA 6 ? Ocelot Jugular, Pfister Neon, Coil Raiden : notes du jeu et guides convergent.
articles.txt:
Pour semer la police dans GTA 6, les guides convergent vers trois voitures vives au démarrage : l’Ocelot Jugular, inspirée de la Jaguar XE SV Project 8, la Pfister Neon, clin d’œil à la Porsche Taycan, et la Coil Raiden, calquée sur la Tesla Model S. Toutes dépassent 7 sur 10 en accélération dans le carnet de véhicules du jeu. Pour encaisser les chocs, le pick-up Truth & Justice Caracara fait référence.
Quelques jours après la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI , les guides de fuite se recoupent. Sportskeeda (liste mise à jour le 24 novembre) privilégie l’accélération et la maniabilité pour slalomer dans le trafic. GTA Six Guides ajoute la robustesse et déconseille les supercars fragiles. Des critères cohérents avec la physique de conduite de GTA 6 .
Côté chiffres, Dexerto a relevé pour 126 voitures les cinq notes sur 10 affichées en jeu : vitesse, accélération, tenue sur asphalte, tenue hors piste et solidité. Ce sont ces valeurs que nous reprenons, à distinguer des impressions de conduite des guides.
Les quatre voitures rapides plafonnent à 3 sur 10 en solidité : mieux vaut éviter tout contact avec les voitures de police.
Alexander Migl, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons Jaguar XE SV Project 8 : la vraie berline derrière l’Ocelot Jugular GTABase et le GTA Wiki s’accordent : la Jugular s’inspire directement de la Jaguar XE SV Project 8. Dévoilée en juin 2017 et montrée au Festival of Speed de Goodwood, cette XE radicale a été préparée par la division Special Vehicle Operations de Jaguar Land Rover : V8 5.0 à compresseur de 600 ch, panneaux en carbone, aileron arrière et disques carbone-céramique de 400 mm.
Produite à 300 exemplaires, elle a signé un temps record de 7 min 21 s 23 sur la boucle Nord du Nürburgring. Les deux autres voitures du trio ont des modèles tout aussi parlants, comme nous l’avons vu avec les voitures électriques de GTA 6 inspirées de Tesla et Porsche .
© Rockstar Games Un classement appelé à bouger Ces choix reposent sur les notes du jeu et les essais de la première semaine : ils évolueront avec les mises à jour et les tests de la communauté. La plus rapide n’est pas forcément la meilleure pour fuir : la Truffade Thrax, reine de la vitesse de pointe , est une hypercar basse peu à l’aise hors du bitume. Sur deux roues, Sportskeeda cite la Maibatsu Manchez pour le tout-terrain ; pour la route, voyez notre classement des meilleures motos de GTA 6 .
Les guides citent surtout l’Ocelot Jugular, la Pfister Neon et la Coil Raiden, toutes au-dessus de 7 sur 10 en accélération.
Le Truth & Justice Caracara : 6,3 sur 10 en solidité et la meilleure note hors piste du jeu.
La Jaguar XE SV Project 8, berline de 600 ch produite à 300 exemplaires.
Non, il peut changer avec les mises à jour du jeu et les nouveaux tests des joueurs.

articles.t: GTA 6 Graphics Settings Leak: 4 Consoles, 0 Confirmed
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 graphics settings reportedly leaked for PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and S via a deleted Pastebin. Rockstar has confirmed none of it.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games A deleted Pastebin document attributed to GTAForums dataminer Tex2 reportedly lists GTA 6 graphics settings for four consoles. KitGuru reported that the deleted leak may have revealed Rockstar’s graphics settings for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. Rockstar Games has not confirmed any of it.
MP1st, The Times of India, iXBT.games and GamesRadar+ also carried the story, which kept it circulating on November 27, 2026. The document is gone, so readers cannot check the original page. That gap matters, and this analysis treats every detail as a report, not as a fact about the shipping game.
The timing adds fuel. Players are still debating what a possible PC version could look like, a thread we followed in our report on the GTA 6 leak for PC gamers and its November build . A console settings list gives that debate new material, even if it proves nothing about PC.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The core claim is simple. A Pastebin document, since deleted, reportedly carried graphics presets for the PS5, PS5 Pro , Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S versions of Grand Theft Auto VI. It did not leak a build, a trailer or a story detail. It leaked a settings list, the kind of data a developer keeps in internal config files or debug menus.
According to the reports, the list covered texture quality, shadow quality, terrain detail, hair quality, global illumination, NPC behavior, pedestrian density and physics quality. Those eight areas span both rendering and simulation. Some tax the GPU, others tax the CPU, and a few hit both. A preset that touches all of them tells you how a studio balances the whole machine, not only the pretty parts.
The presence of NPC behavior, pedestrian density and physics quality stands out. Those options suggest the document describes the full game simulation and not just the visual layer. Open-world games live and die by how many people, cars and objects the engine can keep alive at once, so the CPU side of the list may matter as much as the shadows.
Nothing in the available coverage supplies resolution targets, frame rates or a full value-by-value table that we can verify. Outlets described the document in broad strokes, and we do the same. Any site that prints a complete table of exact values is working from a page that no longer exists.
Reports attribute the Pastebin to Tex2, a member of GTAForums who is described as a dataminer. Dataminers pull information out of game files, patches and builds. Their track records vary widely, and the strongest ones show their work. A deleted paste with no surviving original shows very little.
The attribution itself comes secondhand. Outlets repeat the name because earlier posts and forum threads pointed to it, and not because anyone has proven who posted the paste. Rockstar has not said whether the document is authentic, whether it came from a current build or whether it reflects an older internal state.
Journalists use a rough ladder for leaks. The top rung is a document the publisher confirms. The next is material several independent outlets inspected directly. The bottom rung is a description of something nobody can open any more. This story sits near the bottom, which is why the fact pattern stays modest: four platforms, a few named features and no official word.
Repetition across outlets does not lift a leak up the ladder. Five sites summarizing the same vanished page equal one source, counted five times. Readers should keep that in mind each time a headline treats a leak as settled when its own publisher has not touched it.
One of the more interesting claims is that the PS5 and Xbox Series X settings match. Reports say both consoles use the same mixture of medium and high presets. If that holds, Rockstar treats the two flagship consoles as one performance tier, which is how many multiplatform studios work when the hardware is close.
Parity of that kind is a design decision as much as a technical one. Matching presets let a studio tune once, test once and promise the same experience to two audiences. It also removes the argument over which console runs the game better, at least on paper. Real-world results can still differ because of drivers, memory handling and system software.
The medium and high mixture also tells a story. Neither console reportedly sits at the top of the stack. Roc

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : pourquoi cette fuite PS5 et Xbox inquiète pour votre carte graphique — Frandroid
articles.chapeau: Des fichiers issus de GTA 6 révèlent les réglages graphiques de la PS5 et des Xbox. En croisant la fuite avec les analyses de Digital Foundry, elle donne
articles.txt:
D’après le dataminer Tex2, qui a fouillé les fichiers du jeu, et le site MP1st qui a relayé sa liste ce mercredi 25 novembre, la PS5 et la Xbox Series X utiliseraient les mêmes réglages, surtout en « moyen » et « élevé ». La PS5 Pro ajoute des ombres calculées en ray tracing, ce que Rockstar a confirmé, tandis que la Xbox Series S baisserait la qualité des textures et réduirait même la foule dans les rues. Nous avons détaillé cette fuite ici . Rockstar n’a pas commenté le reste de la liste.
Pour un PC, la conséquence est simple : les cartes graphiques de notre guide de configuration visent ces réglages de console. Pour jouer avec une image plus belle que sur PS5, il faudra davantage de puissance.
Pour l’instant, GTA 6 n’existe que sur PS5 et Xbox Series, où il est sorti le 19 novembre. Rockstar n’a annoncé aucune version PC, mais GamesBeat affirme, sur la foi de quatre sources anonymes, qu’elle est prévue pour le premier trimestre 2027 ; le studio n’a pas commenté. Ce serait bien plus rapide que pour GTA 5 , arrivé sur PC en avril 2015, soit environ un an et sept mois après sa sortie sur PS3 et Xbox 360.
L’information la plus solide vient de Digital Foundry , qui a comparé le jeu sur les quatre consoles. Toutes utilisent le ray tracing, une technique qui simule le trajet de la lumière, pour l’éclairage et les reflets. Même la Xbox Series S, la moins puissante , le conserve, quitte à calculer son image en 720p et à passer souvent sous les 30 images par seconde.
Aucune console ne permet de couper le ray tracing. Cela ne dit pas encore ce que proposera la version PC.
C’est un problème pour les PC équipés d’une carte sans circuits dédiés au ray tracing : GeForce GTX (séries 900, 10 et 16), Radeon RX 500 et RX 5000. Elles représentent encore plus de 13 % des PC du sondage Steam d’octobre 2026 . Certaines GTX savent faire du ray tracing grâce à leur pilote, sans circuits dédiés, mais rien ne garantit qu’elles seraient acceptées par GTA 6, ni assez rapides.
Je passe chez Apple ! Le Black Friday est lancé sur l’univers Apple. Sur Back Market, profitez de promotions sur les iPhone, MacBook, iPad, AirPods et Apple Watch. Chaque appareil est soumis à jusqu’à 100 points de contrôle qualité et est livré avec une garantie de 12 mois. De quoi profiter de performances comparables à celles d’un produit neuf.
Trois scénarios sont possibles, sans qu’on sache lequel Rockstar choisira.
Des circuits de ray tracing obligatoires. Ces cartes seraient alors exclues. C’est le choix d’ Indiana Jones et le Cercle ancien et de Doom: The Dark Ages , qui exigent une carte équipée pour le ray tracing.
Un ray tracing logiciel. Comme dans Star Wars Outlaws ou Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora , le jeu calcule alors le ray tracing sans circuits dédiés, et se lance donc sur ces cartes. Dans les tests de TechPowerUp en 1080p, une Radeon RX 5700 XT y fait jeu égal avec une RX 6600, équipée pour le ray tracing, alors qu’elle la devance d’environ 10 % dans les jeux sans ray tracing.
Un mode PC sans ray tracing. Rockstar l’a fait pour GTA 5 Enhanced, la version modernisée de GTA 5 sur PC : le ray tracing y est facultatif, et une GeForce GTX 1630 suffit au minimum.
Si un tel mode existait, le gain pourrait être important. Dans un test de GTA 5 Enhanced réalisé par le site polonais PurePC , activer le ray tracing fait perdre de 41 à 57 % des images par seconde en 1080p sur ces cartes courantes :
Sur 36 jeux testés en 4K, TechSpot mesure une perte moyenne plus modérée : de 22 à 32 % sur une GeForce RTX 4090, de 29 à 42 % sur une Radeon RX 7900 XTX, selon le niveau de ray tracing.
Ces mesures restent à prendre avec précaution, car GTA 5 est un jeu de 2013 auquel le ray tracing a été ajouté après coup, et PurePC ne l’a testé que sur une seule scène. Elles ne disent pas ce que gagnerait GTA 6 .
Digital Foundry juge d’ailleurs l’éclairage en ray tracing de GTA 5 Enhanced relativement léger pour la carte graphique, mais lourd pour le processeur. Enfin, notre guide suppose le ray tracing activé, comme sur console : ces gains ne s’appliquent pas à ses recommandations.
Avec les calculs de notre dossier , voici ce que donneraient des réglages au plus bas sur trois cartes graphiques très répandues. Ces projections reposent sur des gains mesurés dans d’autres jeux, souvent sur des cartes haut de gamme : ce ne sont que des ordres de grandeur.
En « bas », avec le ray tracing. Dans Red Dead Redemption 2 , du même moteur, ces réglages rapportent environ 13 à 26 % d’images par seco

articles.t: GTA 6 : les réglages graphiques cachés sur PS5, PS5 Pro et Xbox ont fuité — Frandroid
articles.chapeau: Les réglages graphiques de GTA 6 sur PS5, PS5 Pro et Xbox Series ont fuité ce mercredi 25 novembre, extraits des fichiers du jeu par un dataminer. Seule la
articles.txt:
Sur console, GTA 6 n’affiche aucun menu graphique : le jeu de Rockstar, sorti le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series, tourne à 30 images par seconde partout, sans dire ce que chaque machine sacrifie.
Un dataminer surnommé Tex2, qui fouille les fichiers du jeu, a trouvé la liste de ces réglages console par console. Son message sur le forum GTAForums a été supprimé depuis, mais le site MP1st l’a recopié ce mercredi 25 novembre .
La TV Micro RGB 65 » R95H à 1 999€ Black Friday : la TV Samsung Micro RGB 65″ R95H perd 1 000 € et s’affiche à 1 999 € au lieu de 2 999 €, du 21 au 30 novembre. Grâce à sa technologie Micro RGB, il délivre « un niveau de précision et de richesse colorimétrique inédit ».
Premier enseignement : la PS5 et la Xbox Series X utilisent exactement les mêmes réglages. Si la Xbox Series X tient mieux ses 30 images par seconde que la PS5 , la différence vient donc du matériel.
La PS5 Pro est la seule console à calculer les ombres en ray tracing, une technique qui simule le trajet de la lumière pour des ombres plus réalistes. Elle passe aussi l’éclairage global, c’est-à-dire la façon dont la lumière rebondit sur les surfaces, en « High » au lieu de « Medium ».
Pourtant, elle reste bloquée à 30 images par seconde, et aucun mode sans ray tracing ne permet d’échanger ces effets contre de la fluidité. Rockstar l’a justifié par le processeur de la PS5 Pro, trop juste pour faire tourner la simulation du jeu plus vite. Et comme la PS5 et la Series X mélangent déjà réglages moyens et élevés, un mode 60 images par seconde obligerait à les baisser encore , avec une image nettement moins belle.
La Xbox Series S, la moins puissante des quatre consoles, coupe plus large : textures, cheveux et eau perdent un cran. Surtout, la densité de piétons et de voitures passe de « High » à « Medium », comme la physique et le comportement des personnages.
Rockstar n’a toujours pas daté la version PC de GTA 6. En attendant, ces réglages donnent un repère pour estimer la configuration PC nécessaire pour faire tourner GTA 6 à 30 ou 60 images par seconde .

articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar Games) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Threads Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Extremely fast progress is being made with unofficial ports of GTA 6 One of those efforts runs at a stable 25 to 30fps now, but this requires 16GB of video RAM currently That's worrying those who have a graphics card with 12GB or 8GB of VRAM, but this is still very early days for these ports The rapid progress of unofficial PC ports of GTA 6 in the past 24 hours has been incredible to see unfold — but at the same time, what's been aired about the related PC specs for these projects is causing some concern with gamers.
And not just gamers who may be planning to run such an (illegal) unofficial port, but also those thinking about what the system requirements may be for Rockstar's official PC release.
The key info here comes from the 'CGBJ' build which has shared footage of GTA 6 running at a stable 25 to 30fps on PC as I reported earlier today . This port is currently hitting that frame rate on a PC with 8GB of system RAM and an Nvidia GPU that has 16GB of video memory (VRAM), and it's the latter point which is causing some concern.
Brackz on X , who highlighted this progress with the CGBJ project, asked their followers: "Seems like we might be seeing complete builds this weekend, will you be playing?"
And while some gamers do want to play — regardless of any risks associated with an illegal port, and that includes the danger of downloading a fake PC version that's malware in disguise, which are already around incidentally — they're quite worried about that 16GB of VRAM figure. Not many folks have a graphics card with this much memory on board, after all.
Is this really a concern, though – and more broadly, is it any kind of ominous sign for those planning to buy the official version of GTA 6 when Rockstar makes it available?
Well, I certainly wouldn't get carried away with the notion that seeing 16GB of VRAM mentioned in an unofficial port should be any cause for panic at this stage. Mind you, some folks are doing exactly that – panicking – along the lines of : "I hope they optimize it for 8GB VRAM too my broke ass can't afford the 16GB VRAM of AMD and Nvidia sadly."

That's the kind of level that PC gamers are anticipating for the official port from Rockstar, I should note — starting from 8GB of VRAM for 1080p (as the minimum spec) — although this is all guesswork. However, based on the fact that GTA 6 runs on the Xbox Series S, which has 10GB of unified memory for both the system RAM and GPU, this makes sense ( albeit the game isn't that smooth on the lesser Xbox ).
GPU and memory aside, where the PC will also have a strong suit is with the more powerful processors available that should make a big difference in busier areas (such as Vice City), where the consoles are bottlenecked by their relatively modest CPUs.
